response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web software developer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and some low-latency DLang backend work, but the role requires deep hardware expertise in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator performance analysis, GPU architecture, and hardware-software co-design — none of which appear in the resume. Despite 15+ years of software experience meeting the raw years threshold, the domain mismatch is fundamental for a Principal Performance Architect role.
strengths: Long, continuous software engineering career (15+ years) with a Bachelor's in Computer Science
Some performance-oriented experience: low-latency, high-throughput services with async I/O, fibers, and caching at Dunnhumby
Breadth across web, mobile, embedded, and open-source projects, with demonstrated ability to learn new stacks
concerns: No SoC, IP modeling, silicon, or computer architecture experience whatsoever
No GPU, SIMD/MIMD, or AI accelerator workload analysis background; AI exposure is limited to agent tooling (MCP), not DNN training/inference optimization
Career trajectory is web/full-stack product engineering, misaligned with a principal-level hardware performance architecture role

key_factors.factor: No AI accelerator or GPU workload expertise
General software performance and systems experience
